profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at RapidFinance
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: My name is Tracey Turner, I am currently a Full Stack, Lead Software Engineer at Rapid Finance working in .NET, C#.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led collaborative efforts with the CTO, Director of Engineering, and QA Lead to successfully drive the delivery of products and new features, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

- Crafted and executed high-level strategic approaches, translating business requirements into actionable technical specifications, resulting in the achievement of critical business milestones.

- Orchestrated and optimized Tier 4 support processes, elevating the stability and performance of legacy applications, thereby bolstering their longevity and enhancing end-user experience.

- Led and actively contributed to a diverse range of projects encompassing new feature development, major refactoring, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements, leveraging expertise in C# .NET and SQL to deliver outstanding results.

- Actively participated in candidate interviews, playing a pivotal role in recruiting and growing the engineering team with top-tier talent, ensuring the company's continued success in the competitive tech landscape.

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
- Engage closely with key business stakeholders to collaboratively draft and refine comprehensive business requirements, ensuring seamless alignment between technical solutions and organizational objectives.

- Spearhead the design and implementation of high-level technical strategies, translating business needs into robust technical requirements, driving successful project outcomes that contribute to the realization of strategic business goals.

- Foster strong partnerships with software architects, actively contributing to the enhancement of code quality and the pursuit of architectural excellence, resulting in optimized system performance and maintainability.

- Lead and actively contribute to diverse projects encompassing new feature development, major refactoring, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements, employing cutting-edge technologies including .NET and Vue.js to deliver exceptional results.

- Exhibit agility and expertise in working with ad-hoc teams to rapidly identify, mitigate, and resolve critical defects in production systems, minimizing downtime and ensuring seamless user experiences.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Using .NET and C# to manage a variety of websites hosted by the University of Maryland.
